acceptance_predicates.description: Selected-workload capture is redacted, sealed, content-addressed, and bound to the configured provider profile and agent.
Selected/all workload campaign publishes cassette artifacts only after exact complete coverage; partial coverage remains unavailable.
The next run can consume the sealed cassette through strict offline replay with provider network contact denied.
Duplicate, mismatched, corrupt, or incomplete captures fail closed without partial publication.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management never block mock capture or replay.

definition_of_done: Exact-main receipt covers selected and all-workload capture, sealing, incomplete coverage, and strict offline replay.
Independent review and hosted checks pass with no secret-shaped output.

inputs.description: Selected or all workload capture plan and provider/agent identity.

outputs.description: Digest-bound cassette catalog and strict offline qualification evidence.

gates.description: Every replayed cassette is digest-bound and exact-compatible with the selected provider and agent.
Offline replay evidence proves no provider network contact.
